selection: Every CONTINUE_CURRENT failure plus every C4-induced success-to-failure transition; all three branches retained.

push-v3.description: 环境记录的物体到目标距离 / 0.05

reach-v3.description: 环境记录的TCP到目标距离 / 0.05；不以观测前三维冒充TCP

door-open-v3.description: abs(观测[4] - 观测[-3]) / 0.08；不用恒零的obj_to_target

scope: Uses future recorded outcomes and evaluator info for descriptive verification; these arrays must not enter a decision-time selector.
